company_info.company_description: "HDC Electrical & Solar are an experienced Solar and Electrical business, providing an honest and reliable service with over 10 years’ experience in renewables.We pride ourselves on creating a great work culture, with teamwork at its core to create a collaborative and productive work environment,Our team of friendly in-house installers are all either A grade and SAA certified, or electrical apprentices on their way to becoming qualified. We see this as our way of investing in the future and making sure your installation is to the highest possible standard.We only use quality products and back our warranties for your peace of mind. If you are after experience and quality, with great service and a smile, contact us today."

reviews.review_description: Once the blockage caused by a lack of system availability following the government rebates opening up cleared, we got our system and it was installed. During the waiting time HDC kept us informed about what was going on and actually came out to complete as much setup work as possible before the battery and inverter arrived.When everything arrived, they came later that week to install all the gear. They worked long days to try to get everything done as quickly as possible but seemed a cheery crew all the same. They dealt well with our non-standard highly insulated home.Everything is neat, not covered in stickers and seems to be running very well for the first few weeks.

We are delighted with the entire experience provided by HDC Solar & Electrical for the installation of our new solar array, Sigenergy battery, gateway, and EV charger. We found HDC through the Solar Quotes website, and they exceeded our expectations at every stage.Outstanding Sales and Planning:Danielle was exemplary in the initial sales process. She genuinely listened to our requirements and goals, including our specific needs for the system's financial performance with our variable energy plan. Her expertise ensured the chosen system was perfectly sized and correctly quoted for our property. The site visit was thorough, easing any concerns we had about the installation process, especially the integration with our existing setup.Professional Installation and Team:Aiden and his installation team were well-presented, friendly, and highly professional. They worked quickly and efficiently over the two days required for the panels, battery, and EV charger installation, even when facing unexpected challenges on the house.Unheard-of Aftercare and Follow-Up:The commitment to service did not end when the bill was paid. We experienced a minor hiccup between the new Sigenergy system and our existing GoodWe solar array, requiring the team to return a couple of times. Not only were they happy to address the issues, but they also prioritised resolving them promptly.This dedication was backed up by Renee, the General Manager, who called several times to ensure our issue was being sorted, and Danielle continued to check in afterwards. This level of service is truly unheard of in the industry today.The System and Recommendation:The Sigenergy 24 kWh battery, gateway, and EVAC system are exceptional; they look fantastic and operate flawlessly. We are extremely glad we chose this premium brand and, crucially, this expert installer.We would wholeheartedly recommend HDC Solar & Electrical. They couldn't have done a better job of delivering on their promise of quality and professionalism.

Very happy with HDC. Throughout the process they were clear, honest and transparent with their proposal. Installation happened quickly thanks to a well-organised installation team, and all of my follow-up questions were responded to quickly.

The team was fantastic in their communication and service. Special mention To Dani. She was not pushy with her pitch and allowed me time to do my research and get back to her unlike other solar sales. The inverter and the panels are best of breed and the sparkies who did the job were very professional. Highly recommended.

HDC Electrical and solar Installed our system and I have to say that the whole process from start to finish was brilliant. The back up from the office staff was amazing keeping use informed of what was going on and answering all of our questions. That guys and girls who arrived to do the install were great also making the job seem so easy. Once complete they left the place so clean it was like they were  never here. We were very happy with the service from the whole team and would recommend them to everyone. Also great that they are local to the Yarra Valley.
All good small mishap with Ethernet connection otherwise all good

I choose Hdc Electrical, as they are a local company, they were prompt on arriving, the whole team were very helpful with any questions, the installation went smoothly, ladies in the office were lovely to deal with, kept me up to date with lodging the paperwork with Ausnet etc. highly recommend
Seamless and easy to talk with knowledge of the product was excellent
Great service from quoting stage to installation, cannot fault a thing.
Super helpful comms and straightforward installation. Definitely recommend Cam and team

HDC came across as professional and customer focussed.They were not' 'salesmen'.The installation team were on-time, explained what they proposed to do, asked where they could work and gave us updates as they progressed.When they finished they cleaned up, showed us that the PV system was working on the App and explained that the Inspection would occur in about 1 week.It is now working beautifully.Highly recommended.

My experience with the team at HDC Electrical was excellent. I selected HDC because they recommended a site consultation. The boss of HDC,who is an accredited electrician / solar installer visited my house and provided advice and options re shading concerns. HDC's quote was extremely competitive. The office staff handled the administration perfectly and helped me apply for Government rebates, promptly responding to all queries. The installation went smoothly and without issue. The HDC team took care with the installation, for example they used padding so that the ladder would not scratch the edge of colorbond gutter! This is he first time I have experienced a contractor do this and take such care. HDC cleaned the site, cleaned the gutters and swept the garden paths leaving the house tidy. The customer service was so good I also purchased an iStore heat pump hot water system through HDC and was not disappointed. HDC's plumber was also excellent and offered to add a new water tap for me where my old gas HWS was removed. All piping was tidy and professional. All site visits were on time with tracking app. HDC is the best contractor / business I have dealt with!

I had a number of quotes and after lots of research went with HDC Electrical and we are so glad we did. Although not the cheapest quote they offered the best value for the system we wanted and were really efficient at all stages of the process. Liked the way they not only quoted online but took the trouble to actually come out to the house to discuss the installation and they were the only company to get on the roof and do a proper measure up so that we got the best possible panel layout.The installation took 2 days and the guys arrived on time and did a super job.It's early days but so far we are very happy with our solar installation by HDC and would highly recommend them.

Just had my new solar system installed by HDC. They were excellent across the board. From the quotation process right through to the installation. I did my research and had quite a few quotes - they were not the cheapest but still very competitive. They were the only company to actually come out and go on the roof to measure up so we got the panel layout we wanted.Communication from the start was very efficient - quotes came through quickly and all questions were answered. The guys who came to install the system pick a super job and were very professional. Highly recommend.

From the first contact, HDC was great to deal with and provided a fast quote matching what I was looking for. An installer then came on-site to inspect my roof and even suggested a better layout, after which I approved the quote. Installation was organised quickly and efficiently with the on-site team being punctual and tidy, without any issues during installation. The team walked me through the app installation for the inverter and is organising grid connection.Zero complaints from me, well done team.

Quotes.All the suppliers were prompt and provided competitive quotes. We chose what i felt was the best overall aesthetic and technical offering.   Cost a little more but looks great.Installation.The installer we chose was on time, professional and neat and the installed system looks great on our roof.   The black Trina 440W panels, Enphase IQ8AC inverters and iBoard distribution board all perfectly matched and perform flawlessly.Customer Service was great with regular communication up to the installation date.   Just completed and passed  inspection now waiting for the feed in tariff to start.My only disappointments were the excessive time to approve my Vic Gov rebate (4 weeks) and the final inspection and sign off (2 weeks).Over six weeks of red tape and one day to install the system.

The quoting process was quick and easy.  HDC turned up when they arranged and advised when they were 20 minutes away.The installation was when agreed even though the weather was pretty ordinary on the day. Note they arrive early (7:30am).. No rubbish was left behind and nothing was too much trouble.The approvals and the process was quickly done via online processes.  HDC responded quickly to any questions that I had.Still getting my head around all the options on the Zappi charger as it depends on what the weather is like as to what is the best option.  The cheapest charge option is when the system is generating electricity. My cheapest rate for charging from the retailer (on an EV Plan) is between 12 midnight and 7am so you need to choose between holding off the night rate if the sun is going to shining the next morning.

From the first phone call, I experienced highly professional and expert service from HDC Electrical and Solar.Renne listened to all the various options I had in mind and took time to discuss and help me work through the aspects of each one.There was no pushy selling, but careful and considered advice.The proposal I settled on was perfect for our situation and a very reasonable price.I was given clear instructions on how to proceed and the administrative aspects were handled efficiently. Renee and Angel made the whole process run like clockwork.The installation happened quickly, less than a week from paying the deposit.Mitchell, Cameron and the team were onsite exactly when they said they would be and all was completed seamlessly and tidily.The post installation process also was very smooth with the inspection happening about a week later.I was all hooked up and making solar electricity within 3 weeks of my first call to HDC Electrical and the system is running beautifully.Can highly recommend HDC Electrical and Solar.

HDC were a pleasure to deal with.  They provided great customer service and Cam was open an honest with the site inspection as part of the quote process.Installation team were well organised, punctual and thorough.
Couldn’t fault HDC from quote to finished install. Very professional, great price and quality work.Have recommended them to family and friends

Our house presented a challenging roof line, making it crucial to find an installer capable of optimising our solar installation. After engaging with multiple installers who would only quote remotely and struggled to grasp the unique constraints of our roof, we were very happy when Cameron from HDC committed to personally assessing the site and walking the roof before providing a quote. This was the start of a successful collaboration with Cameron and the HDC team.The entire process was as promised, with consistent communication leading up to the installation. The HDC team were punctual, efficient, polite and friendly throughout. The installation itself was executed to a high-quality standard, and the team ensured our site was left neat and orderly. Despite the inherent difficulties posed by our roof, the team persevered and successfully completed the installation as scheduled.Following the installation, HDC promptly coordinated the electrical inspection and facilitated the connection with our energy supplier, allowing us to promptly reap the benefits of our new system. We are exceptionally pleased with the performance of our solar setup and have no reservations about recommending Cameron and the HDC team for your solar installation needs.

HDC communicated promptly and were happy to address questions or changes to our quote.Again, when it came to installation they did everything on time, with a professional attitude and smooth installation.Our energy provider caused us some trouble, but Renee at HDC was very helpful in communicating with them and guiding us through the grid connection process.Very happy with everything from start to finish.

From start to finish Cameron and the team at HDC did a thorough job. Shortly after our inquiry, Cameron was on the roof working out our best solution.We were walked through the process, which was made extremely easy, in addition office staff were a delight to deal with.The team doing the installation on the day arrived as planned, minimal disruption and zero mess left behind.We are happy with our system and how it performs, it is doing everything that we were told it would do.After installation, we were equally impressed with HDC arranging and making contact with our energy supplier.

HDC Electrical and Solar were very helpful, answering all our questions, providing great advice and conducted a site visit before quoting. Turned up on time, were very efficient and installation was  completed to a high standard. Fully explained how it all worked and tidied up afterwards. System is performing well and they organised all compliance checks promptly.
Cam and Renee is amazing, so is their Install Team...  Nothing but praises for HDC Electrical and Solar!

Sales and quoting process was smooth and easy to use. The installation was also smooth, timely, worked tirelessly across the day to complete, and the customer service was also very good in terms of helping me follow up missing emails, getting my grid connection sorted with my certificate and everything else in terms of alerting my supplier afterwards.

Thank You Solar quotes for good advice and referral to 3 good suppliers. Decision was based on system specification and pricing. HDC electrical have installed the system. Owner went through with us our needs and specifications. Cameron visited on site. All his staff who installed the panels and inverter were extremely polite and friendly. Fully explained the installation process and timing. Operated in a safe manner meeting all site requirements. System now installed. Awaiting inspector to visit within coming week.Highly recommend Solarquotes and HDC Electrical. Looking forward to going active shortly.Regards Mark

From start to finish, the whole team at HDC Electrical and Solar were amazing. They were professional and nothing was too much trouble. From the quotation stage with Cameron, Installation by Mitch and support from Renee and Angel, they all went above and beyond to make sure everything was right and all of my questions were answered. I love my new solar system and would highly recommend HDC.
Extremely neat job grid connection no hassles recommend h d c electrical and solar to anybody interested

We are 3 days away from electrical inspection of the system.The installation went all well. We were well-informed of all the steps in advance and always felt everything important was taken care of.The advice given by Hugh was very good with a budget system and a higher quality system quoted. It makes sense to spend a bit extra on better equipment.What was important to me was that Hugh, the sales person, was not pushy for me to make a decision.The whole process can be a bit drawn out but that's not HDC's fault. It's the way the system works (paper work etc)The guys spent about 4-5 hours on the roof for 17 panels.Very happy so far. Hopefully it'll work flawlessly for many years.

Highly recommend!Very professional compaly all round. Customer service is excellent, installers were safe, competent and had good communication. Very neat work. I've had a lot of interaction with tradies recently and this company were the only one that actually let you know when they'll turn up to your property, and do actually turn up! Renee even sorts out all the paperwork too.

Through out the whole process HDC where excellent.  They explained everything in a way that it was easy for us to understand.  The instillation team where a delight to have on our property.  The end of the process involving Solar Vic and our electricity retailer was handled exceptionally.  Thank you HDC.  Will be recommending you to everyone i know!

Hugh helped me through many many quotes during my installer selection.Once the deposit was paid the installation was scheduled with the following weeks. They showed up on time and installed within the time frame they estimated. The install work was very neat and the system was operational within the agreed timeframes.They then followed up once installed and arranged the necessary notifications to the energy supplier and retailer.Great result and a great install.

HDC Electrical and Solar gave us A+ service throughout the whole process of our commercial solar installation. The quotation and proposal was in-depth with plenty of information, we received plenty of help and details regarding rebates, and the installation was efficient and didn't affect our business trade. The whole team have been great a big thank you for all their help and patience

No question was too hard or went unanswered in a very timely manner.  Installation went very smoothly with the guys being very helpful and informative.  Kept the area very neat and tidy and cleaned up very well before they left. Everything was done for me,  I had to do nothing. Excellent service.

I'm a happy customer.  I selected HDC as their pricing was good, and they were fairly local.  They did a great job.  The electrical inspector when inspecting the job commented that Cam's work was always so neat.

Pretty easy process with Cam, Hugh and Renee answering all the questions honestly and providing a quality system for our home/needs, rather than the usual quick sell with an inadequate system you get with other companiesTurnaround time was quick with no disruption which is a big bonus

HDC was my second choice, although cheaper than my first. Hugh explained that they only did site inspections once they were the preferred installer. Due to a number of issues our decision was put off for 10 months, at which time I was unable to contact our preferred supplier, who no longer responded to my phone calls. I called Hugh at HDC and discussed my need for shade-proof Solar Panels with future-proofing.  Hugh gave me a clear explanation, meeting my own technical (engineering) experience with clear knowledge and recommendations that convinced me I was getting a first-class system.We agreed to proceed, and the HDC quote went to SolarVic for processing - approval was simple and HDC fitted our installation into a convenient slot just 2 weeks after SolarVic's approval.Cam and his team, arrived - despite early rain (which cleared quickly) and by the mid-afternoon our installation was complete! 18 panels on a tile roof in less than a day!Cam explained how everything worked, and reset our Heat Pump hot water to a 10 am-3 pm timer slot.The system upload to Enphase took a couple of days longer than expected, but 10 days after the installation I can watch our panels supplying our house with lovely solar power. My Powerpal shows big slabs of 'no-need' electricity.  Sadly, the winter sun slides behind our front yard pine trees too much, but all the panels individually get glimpses of the sun and continue producing. I'm very happy with the installation and look forward to Summer.  I see a visit from an arborist in our future.The grid connection was handled by HDC. Once we signed up with HDC they did everything, including advising Origin of the change.  The system inspector arrived just 48 hours (or less?) after system completion.

Absolutely excellent installations, local installers to The Valley and S.E. Vic. My installs for all my family and friends were brilliant. I would highly recommend this company for all your Solar/Battery needs. A+++

We were very pleased with the quoting from Hugh. He answered all our questions clearly and satisfactorily Cam visited and explained the layout to our satisfaction. The instillation went extremely well seeing the weather was. The site was left spotless Would definitely use HDC again

The initial interaction with Hugh was excellent, we had an engaging conversation around the house, utilisation, etc to help right size and position a good fit. He offered ideas, thoughts and views on the industry which were relevant and helped make the decision easier. One thing he said early on was that everyone will offer much the same thing, for much the same price, and go with who you think will do the best job. This was pretty accurate as all the quotes we got were in the same ballpark, but didn't fill me with confidence like HDC did. After Cam came out to verify the quote, I felt very confident these guys knew what they were doing - and had no hesitation in giving them the job.We were getting our roof repaired and painted before installing solar, and the weather wasn't too kind and we had to push our installation date back a few times. This was not an issue and Renee kept in contact so we could lock in the first available date once the roof was ready. Cam and the team were great, and installation went well. Everything was installed very quickly on the day. The guys were on time, professional, and respectful. We've had a few trades at the house recently and these guys were the best to deal with.All the administration side was seamless, and minimal fuss from me. Communicated well with me, the power company and I really couldn't have asked for more. Would happily recommend these guys!

I carried out extensive research  across a wide range of solar companies, and was very pleased to find and engage a capable and well informed small solar install company in our local Yarra Valley area.HDC offer a prompt and personable service, and are very approachable to deal with, including flexibility in equipment selection. Their knowledge of the various systems is solid and it is evident that their goal is to achieve the best solution for their client's needs.Our installation, its completion, and subsequent grid connection,  together with the follow-up servicing maintenance by Redback has been efficient and effective.
Great service on the installation and great follow up service.

I started talking to HDC when we were building the house. They gave me the information required to pre-wire, well before I had signed a contract. Although I obtained numerous other quotes, HDC Solar was a clear winner for me - price was equivalent to others, but customer service was well above any other solar installer I spoke to. It was a fantastic balance of  speed and information - without the pushy salesperson that I found with some of the larger solar companies.Install was great, they went beyond to make sure we had the system we wanted, and the solar install was extremely tidy. I got a full run-down of the system and felt confident it was installed correctly.I highly recommend HDC Solar.

This was a real smooth process.HDC proposed a system and after a few discussions and a site visit we decided on the placement of the panels and inverter.The customer service was excellent. Everyone I dealt with were helpful and polite.The installation work was good and tidied up afterwards. I was surprised how quick the installation was. All the paper work was handled by HDC.Cannot complain about anything.So far the system works quite well

Main reason we selected HDC was because they were slightly cheaper overall, and still provided excellent sales support. All three quotes were similar, and all three processes were very good, so it literally became a choice of taking a slightly cheaper quote.That being said, the installation work after accepting the quote was also extremely good. We got treated as a client who wanted a prompt service, and we got slotted into their schedule very quickly and easily. There was no mucking around or unnecessary hold up.Everything was installed well, tidied up afterward, and all the paperwork handled without much involvement from me. Cannot complain about anything! We paid for one of the best systems and got it.
Very happy with the company from a sales, installation and services perspective. Would recommend.

Very happy with the company we chose. All information on delivery and installation explained previously and all on time. All paperwork sent for rebates and completion to existing energy company.Coming back at later date to map panels on app, after grid connection.

Cameron knows what he's doing and was prepared to spend a lot of time explaining various systems and components, in order to help us to choose the best setup for our circumstances. We are very happy with our system, the quality of the work, and the quality of the components used.Our installation took a single day and the team arrived promptly, caused minimal disruption to our routine, and by late afternoon we had a working system with all mess cleaned up.Post-installation customer service has been excellent, with Cameron prepared to answer promptly a couple of queries we had. The system is functioning well and we are happy to recommend HDC Solar to future clients.

Very happy with the whole process.  Several phone calls with Hugh going over different design ideas, explaining how things work, exploring pros and cons and alternatives, quoting on a few systems to settle on a great outcome at a very nice price. No pressure, no stress, taking time to be helpful.Installation was done promptly and professionally by Cam and his team of 3 - punctual, motivated, hard-working, friendly and with care, including complete clean-up.  (And that's after coming from the far side of Melbourne and with strong winds and heavy rain forecast.)  Replaced our ancient switchboard too.Their service has always been helpful, friendly, quick and courteous.  They have taken care of grid connections and everything else official that they are allowed to be, so there was very little that we needed to do.We strongly recommend HDC for solar systems:  some of the cheapest quotes for quality systems with brilliant service and professional installation.(Today the electricity company started recording the power we put into the grid.  A wet cold winter's day but still almost $2 earned, so that's a good start and Summer will be much better.)

The sales/quoting process was really well done, they were detailed in their description and spent a lot of time answering my questions.The installation was done on time and the installers were professional. Some rubbish left around the installation site (screws, metal bits, etc)There were some issues with the installation but they came back straight away to remedy the issue. I really appreciated their swift response and thoroughness in insuring everything was working properly.Would recommend them :)
Great company to deal with from start to completion. Very happy to recommend them to friends and family.

Sales quoting process was thorough and well informed. But I didn’t realise my electricity charge would increase fro so ausnet and or origin without any consultationThe installation was efficient and tidy
Good customer service. Clean install. All working well. Took care of all admin with electricity retailer etc.

Hugh took the time to go through the quote with me after rounds of changes and comparisons.   Cameron and the team were able to fit into my schedule and arrived on time, did a good job on the large installation which kept the boys busy all day.  Small issues were quickly fixed by the team.  Neat tidy, quick and efficient.  Would use again, maybe one day for Battery.  Highly Recommended.

Good up front discussions, answered all our questions, flexible with changes and timing. Prompt responses to emails, thoughtful discussion around delivery, thorough pre and on site inspection beforehand. Painless installation with a thoughtful and focussed crew.

Options for the system were well described.The installation went ahead without a hitch. There was some initial monitoring difficulty but that was resolved quickly.Grid connection was straight forward and now we are saving heaps.

I couldn't have been more happier from the very start with HDC Solar Solutions. Hugh was very helpful with the solar layout, very knowledgeable with the equipment and was very easy to deal with.The install process was faultless. The team led by Cam were ran me through everything on the day before commencing work. The installed panels and inverter look nice and straight which is very important to me. The guys cleaned up all excess materials once finished.The team did all the relevant paperwork to connect the solar system to the relevant companies which saved me a lot of time.Thanks to the team at HDC Solar Solutions.

Following discussion as to our needs the quoting process ran smoothly. The Electrician followed up with a site visit and provided valuable contribution to helping establish our system to cover all our needs and additional capacity to support an  electric vehicle in the longer term.The installation was performed on time and within budget, providing us a total return on investment within 3 years, including the battery.The installers were neat and tidy and they provided grid installation and app  support.We have recommended this organization to our friends
Friendly genuine service, competitive pricing, professional workmanship. Extremely happy. Thankyou Cameron, Hugh and Harriet. Highly recommend you. Great experience.
The entire process from start to finish was very well organised and executed. Extremely professional, punctual and spotless clean up. Great team of men working brilliant together. Highly recommended.
Thanks Hugh for designing a fantastic system, fits our needs perfectly. Every one of the HDC team were great and did Fantastic job on the installation and all the paper work. Job Well done.

Well organised & planned. Support through application process. Installation went smoothly & panels working brilliantly. Only delay which was outside HDCs control, was inspection now taking 2 to 4 weeks.Overall very pleased with result.

All my questions were easily answered, no matter how trivial, and offered a good price.  The job was booked in and the team arrived on time, did the job with minimal fuss, and cleaned up after themselves better than I've ever seen tradies do before.  The system is doing what was promised. Very happy to recommend them.

Cameron, Hugh, and Harriet have been lovely to deal with- it was easy to feel like they were actually listening to me.  The install was earlier than expected, and so quick.  They were the tidiest tradespeople I have ever seen!  Followup has been great too.  Thanks guys!
Cameron is man of word. very smooth experience. his staffs were just best tradies. Highly recommended.Great quality of work. punctual on job.
I can highly recommend Cameron & HDC Electrical. Quality of workmanship, pricing and equipment and communication is something I can not fault.
Quoting, installation and customer service all achieved with efficiency, punctuality and a human touch.

Cameron was a pleasure to deal with. In the quoting process, he listened to what we wanted, asked us important questions that we hadn't considered (I'd say we were pretty well informed), and wasn't selling us anything we weren't interested in - unlike some others, again a demonstration of listening!He offered great value for money - he wasn't the cheapest or the most expensive, but he offered great service and advice, he is passionate about his own small business and local; all the things we should all support!The team that came to do the install were friendly and courteous; importantly they turned up on time and communicated with us throughout the process. When the install was complete, the team helped us download the Enphase Enlighten app and showed us the features, explained the next steps and answered all of our questions.I have recommended HDC to other friends and am confident they'll get the same level of service.Great job guys!
On time, on budget and great communication. Would happily recommend Cameron and his team.
I would not hesitate to use HDC electrical again.
